verdict.rationale: Orb's docs show strong support for usage-based billing infrastructure — customizable billable metrics with full SQL control (orb-docs-5, orb-docs-18, orb-docs-30), minimums/maximums (orb-docs-20), credit alerts and token top-ups/commitments (orb-docs-29, orb-docs-37), and no-code subscription/plan edits via UI or API (orb-docs-10, orb-docs-31, orb-docs-38) — which together enable flexible pricing without custom code. However, the evidence never explicitly names or documents tiered, volume, graduated, or per-unit pricing structures as distinct configurable models, so the specific breadth of pricing shapes claimed in the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing model types and worked examples of hybrid subscription+usage+overage configurations.
